lines.text: Hey, nice to meet ya. I’m LeBooBoo. Richard and Yu have been working real hard on the game. Trust me, I’ve been living here the whole month…

Rich let me crash in a spare room. Some guys are filming a new show at my haunted cabin. They said I could stay during filming, but they broke out the whole ghost radar, and it just got a little awkward. But hey! You should visit some time. Awesome tube run right out back - anyways…
Richard and Yu are getting into costume, and they will be down soon. I’ll have you head into the control room, and take us live when you’re ready.
